decision.decision_meaning: Author-review readiness and primary claim support only; not a journal acceptance prediction. EPA is retrospective. Secondary pointwise contrasts cannot override the primary outcome.

report.interpretation: Retrospective EPA analysis. One primary comparison; secondary intervals are pointwise exploratory. Seeds are averaged as repeated fits, not independent observations.

development.interpretation: Rescues mean erroneous baseline singleton calls converted to deferral, not corrected positive diagnoses. Missing outcomes remain in budget denominators. Strata are descriptive; repeated seeds are not independent molecules.

retrospective_epa.interpretation: Rescues mean erroneous baseline singleton calls converted to deferral, not corrected positive diagnoses. Missing outcomes remain in budget denominators. Strata are descriptive; repeated seeds are not independent molecules.

synthetic_mechanisms.interpretation: Controlled simulations only; separate from all molecular estimands.
